owned-wit-receivers:
    name: WIT receiver methods and properties
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 150
    steps:
      - name: Check out the exact revision
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: npm
      - name: Install Nix
        uses: cachix/install-nix-action@v31
      - name: Install dependencies without lifecycle scripts
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - name: Prepare the pinned WIT and native toolchains
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential cmake pkg-config zstd ripgrep libgmp-dev
          bash scripts/bootstrap-toolchains.sh --lean-only
          bash scripts/bootstrap-toolchains.sh --wasm-tools-only
          nix build .#wasmtime-c-api --out-link build/wasmtime-c-api
      - name: Execute WIT receiver acceptance
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          export LEAN_BRIDGE_WASMTIME_C_API="$PWD/build/wasmtime-c-api"
          source scripts/env.sh
          npm run test:owned-wit-receivers 2>&1 | tee build/wit-owned-receivers.log
          rg '^# tests 20$' build/wit-owned-receivers.log
          rg '^# pass 20$' build/wit-owned-receivers.log
          rg '^# fail 0$' build/wit-owned-receivers.log
          rg '^# cancelled 0$' build/wit-owned-receivers.log
          rg '^# skipped 0$' build/wit-owned-receivers.log
          test -s build/owned-wit-receivers/ordinary.json
          test -s build/owned-wit-receivers/ordinary-plain.json
          test -s build/owned-wit-receivers/ordinary-consuming.json
          test -s build/owned-wit-receivers/ordinary-unanchored.json
          test -s build/owned-wit-receivers/ordinary-package.json
          test -s build/owned-wit-receivers/ordinary-plain-package.json
          test -s build/owned-wit-receivers/ordinary-consuming-package.json
          test -s build/owned-wit-receivers/ordinary-unanchored-package.json
          test -s build/owned-wit-receivers/reviewed.json
          test -s build/owned-wit-receivers/reviewed-plain.json
          test -s build/owned-wit-receivers/reviewed-consuming.json
          test -s build/owned-wit-receivers/reviewed-unanchored.json
          test -s build/owned-wit-receivers/reviewed-package.json
          test -s build/owned-wit-receivers/reviewed-plain-package.json
          test -s build/owned-wit-receivers/reviewed-consuming-package.json
          test -s build/owned-wit-receivers/reviewed-unanchored-package.json
      - name: Preserve WIT receiver execution
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: owned-wit-receivers-${{ github.sha }}
          path: |
            build/wit-owned-receivers.log

            build/owned-wit-receivers/ordinary-plain.json
            build/owned-wit-receivers/ordinary-consuming.json
            build/owned-wit-receivers/ordinary-unanchored.json
            build/owned-wit-receivers/ordinary-package.json
            build/owned-wit-receivers/ordinary-plain-package.json
            build/owned-wit-receivers/ordinary-consuming-package.json
            build/owned-wit-receivers/ordinary-unanchored-package.json
            build/owned-wit-receivers/reviewed.json
            build/owned-wit-receivers/reviewed-plain.json
            build/owned-wit-receivers/reviewed-consuming.json
            build/owned-wit-receivers/reviewed-unanchored.json
            build/owned-wit-receivers/reviewed-package.json
            build/owned-wit-receivers/reviewed-plain-package.json
            build/owned-wit-receivers/reviewed-consuming-package.json
            build/owned-wit-receivers/reviewed-unanchored-package.json
          if-no-files-found: error

keeps prior receipts unchanged. Callback-result anchors and the final Docker

## WIT/WASI receiver acceptance

Run the method and property gate with the pinned Lean, native C, Wasmtime C API
and wasm-tools dependencies available:

```sh
npm run test:owned-wit-receivers
```

The gate requires 20 passing tests and no skips. Both source paths execute
receiver and remaining-parameter anchors, consuming methods, callbacks, returned
closures and recursive values through real Component Model calls. Ten compiled
broken adapters must fail semantic assertions. Resource-only and unanchored
callable configurations also run independently, including Unit properties.
ASan/UBSan checks compare an initialized cold Lean process against the exercised
process; bridge allocation and identity counters must finish at zero.

Installed tests use the public CLI, remove producer sources, install offline,
relocate archives, compare independent rebuilds, reject altered receipts and
verify loaded dependencies. The full package test executes the exact consumer
documentation example. The separate CI job requires all 16 JSON reports in
`build/owned-wit-receivers/` and retains `build/wit-owned-receivers.log`.
